scope: Final batch: chapters 71–81, fifty-five full independent JA/KO/DE/FR/ES essays, synchronized ZH/EN editing and offline Traditional Chinese. Clean baseline 03e5eb0. No translation service, no source-paper edits, no changes outside this batch and its integration boundaries.
style: Read every entire original Chinese essay and adopted source panel, then the corrected Chinese manuscript when available. Preserve substantive arguments, useful examples, authorial warmth and chapter connections. Native essays, not summaries or paragraph-by-paragraph translation. Usually 1500–2200 European words, substantial JA/KO; completeness is judged by coverage, not padding. Retain prescribed section counts. Use developed paragraphs and varied openings/endings rather than a repeated checklist formula. Keep textual calibration beside the disputed reading, without turning every paragraph into a disclaimer. Do not invent autobiographical scenes; original Silicon Valley observations may remain.

global_calibration: The site's panels are adopted editorial texts, not untouched uniform Mawangdui transcripts; do not modify frozen panels. Use adopted versus received wording, not the unsupported claim that all later variants are intentional corruption. Author's new word readings are philosophical rereadings, not proven exclusive dictionary meanings. Distinguish norm/metaphor from empirical universal law. No guaranteed moral repayment, immunity, success through humility, or victim blame. Noncontention coexists with rights, fair credit, protection, necessary resistance and institutional change. No hiding poor treatment behind self-sacrifice, simplicity or anti-ego advice. The series follows received chapter numbering; Mawangdui ordering differs, so chapter81 is this reading route's close, not provably Laozi's final authorial sentence or silk manuscript's end.

71.coverage: 7 sections: confident novice/cautious expert opening; 知不知 with map and33; 不知不知 vs 不知知 plus Dunning–Kruger and novice/veteran; Socrates parallel; 病病 plus Silicon Valley engineers; practical checking;70/72 transitions.
71.corrections: Confidence is not a diagnostic of ignorance, caution not proof of expertise. Dunning–Kruger: original task-specific research on overestimating performance; avoid universal inverse-confidence curve or calling people idiots, no claim philosophy anticipates scientific result. Received 不知知 can mean unrecognized ignorance, not necessarily conscious pretending. 病 is fault/affliction metaphor, not exclusion of ordinary illness; first病 in病病 commonly regard fault as fault/be troubled by it, not literally 'see clearly'. Knowing limits reduces avoidable error, not immunity. Socrates familiar 'I know nothing' slogan is a paraphrase; attribute to Plato Apology21d, not exact quote; no secure simultaneous Laozi/Socrates dates, cultural independence proof or truth proved by two thinkers agreeing. Preserve analogy, explicitly different contexts. Learned expertise can be confident with stated grounds; check reasons, not modest mannerisms.

72.coverage: 8 sections: self-confidence versus superiority; 民不畏威; 狎其所居 with commute/workload/concerns; 厌其所生 and manager/parent/platform deciding enough; self-knowledge/love versus display/superiority plus Silicon Valley;去彼取此; practices;64–72 group retrospective and73 entry.
72.corrections: Fear can persist; no universal depletion clock or promised backlash. 大威 has interpretive range. 狎 light treatment and intrusion/oppression readings coexist. 厌 oppression/weariness/satiety readings must be acknowledged: 'do not decide they already have enough' is the series' modern extension, not established exclusive translation of 毋厌其所生/夫唯弗厌. Not endlessly optimizing others or refusing their own contentment. Self-love permits saying no, fair pay and public explanation; visible self-confidence needn't conceal insecurity. 去彼取此 can require practice and restraint; insight doesn't automatically erase habits or eliminate effort. Grouping is modern editorial, not ancient composition; preview81 adopted 人之道, not 圣人之道.

73.coverage: 7 sections: courage to decline hot project/offer/angry message; two courages and invisible avoided losses; 天所恶孰知其故; four clauses of Heaven and plans/dialogue/sea; net image/fire/trust/good unseen work; practices; final nine-chapter route.
73.corrections: 敢 contextual boldness/daring, not provably neutral everywhere. 杀/活 grave contrast not statistical rule. 孰知其故 retains uncertainty, not certain rhetorical question with scientifically known answer. 天 can have multiple ancient meanings; naturalistic reading is this essay's choice, not proof no religious register. 善应 primarily respond aptly, not secure response from others; dialogue application okay. 繟然而善谋 is NOT 不谋: three不 plus a calm-planning clause; do not invent fourth不. Adopted不战 vs received不争 not proof deliberate dilution. Not initiating doesn't guarantee being left alone; defensive/protective action valid. Net is moral/cosmological image, not a causal theorem promising every harm punished/every effort repaid. Consequences may spread or remain unseen, victims can bear them; unseen good worth need not rest on future reward.

74.coverage: 7 sections: boss seizing specialist decision; capital punishment stakes and three hypotheticals; fear/death/72; 司杀 and 畸/奇; master carpenter image, parent/manager/professional examples, why takeover tempting, oversight vs displacement; practices;75 link.
74.corrections: 恒且 not lexical proof people were already made chronically fearless. 不畏死 doesn't mean anyone under hardship inevitably fearless; threats can still harm. 司杀者 has natural/heavenly/death-order and human-office readings; modern judicial independence analogy must be explicitly limited, not ancient institutional proof or endorsement of executions. Separate expertise from authority and legitimacy: lawful procedure, scrutiny, protection, appeal matter; office or skill doesn't license killing. 畸/奇 doesn't prove deeds vs permanent identity, retain distinction as ethical application. Substitution risk falls on others as well as decision-maker; no guaranteed payback. Rare substitute injury doesn't logically prove master injury. Tacit skills learnable through practice, not irretrievably unteachable. Delegation not no oversight; intervene for safety/abuse appropriately. Ending75 honors revised political reading rather than returning to 'don't value your own life'.

75.coverage: 8 sections: disengaged hard worker; three causal lines tax/intervention/life-burden; 不治/难治 comparison plus65; 有以为 with growth/efficiency/for-your-good; 求生之厚 living costs and74; 无以生为 shielding/resources/conditions; practices;72/74/76 links.
75.corrections: Received 难治 ALSO explicitly blames rulers'有为: do not claim grammatical subject/blame reversed by that variant or intentional corruption. WangBi even says 皆由上不由其下. Third clause subject varies across editions; 求生之厚 can include rulers' lavish pursuit of life or intense pursuit/preservation of life, while burden-of-subsistence is adopted social reading, not exclusive厚 definition. 有以为 doesn't inherently mean dishonest pretext; legitimate purposes can still obscure costs, but not every intervention/opportunity is colonization. 无以生为 political application explicit, not categorical claim every grammatical subject is ruler. Don't diagnose disengagement from one cause; poverty can constrain without abolishing hope/care/fear. Institutions/actions/support can improve conditions; noninterference not abandonment or refusal of aid/regulation.76 transition quote must match frozen panel (no 筋肕).

76.coverage: 7 sections: hand/branch opening; soft-hard life-death image and rigid person/team/system; 微细 tender shoot/principles; army and 梗/折 plus tree/typhoon/bamboo illustrations; strong below supports vulnerable novice/idea/project; practices;36/43/66/77/78 links.
76.corrections: Replace headline/universal 'all living things soft' and false 'hard wood blocks all water and dies'. Living trees have hard supporting/conducting tissue; hardness isn't death and rigidity of disabled/aging bodies isn't moral failure. Corpse/plant comparison is selected image not biological classification. 梗 has interpretive/variant uncertainty, not settled vascular blockage or original right versus折wrong. Bamboo can break and large trees survive storms; outcomes depend on conditions, bending not immunity and victims not to blame. Strong army doesn't always lose; arrogance/inflexibility warning. 柔弱微细 is responsiveness/growth image, not worth depends on continual productivity. Boundaries/stable safeguards can be needed. ‘强大居下’ leadership application, not universal physics/architecture theorem or only strong people can care.

77.coverage: 8 sections: resource-rich receive more; adjusting bow; 天道损余益不足 with water/heat/land images; human accumulation feedback/team budgets; 奉于天/奉天下; three relinquishmentscredit/possession/display; practices;73/2/10/3/78 links.
77.corrections: Natural equalization examples are bounded analogies, not universal cosmic redistribution; nature also concentrates and destroys, no reassurance time makes everyone equal. Bow illustration not precision archery manual. 人之道 tendency under conditions, not immutable human nature/no wrongdoing ever; avoid asserting Laozi's tone provably neutral or he calls it自然. 有余奉于天=emulation is commentary; 奉天下 not necessarily condescending charity. Material redistribution, rules and institutional action remain important; don't reduce unequal resources to personal ego. Title must not tell deprived readers they necessarily have surplus self to cut. Credit, wages, visibility and rights may be deserved; relinquish monopoly over credit, not authorship or dignity. Giving resources can really help, no gift-as-domination generalization.

78.coverage: 8 sections: failed project/responsibility; water/stones/canyon and modern waterjet; knowing-not-doing in argument70; 受垢leadership and badnews; 邦/国 historical transmission; 正言若反41/45 plus not allcontrarian true; practices;water/support thematic closure79.
78.corrections: Water not literally invulnerable or uniquely able to erode; 无以易之 commonly replace but no exclusion of all other glosses. Steel cutting typically abrasive waterjet with machinery/pressure, not plain softness or patience proving doctrine. Knowledge/action gap more than weak will: skills/support/constraints matter. 受 does not lexically prove voluntary choice; assumption of responsibility mustn't mean scapegoating, hiding wrongdoing, forced unpaid emotional labor or unsafe self-sacrifice. Need truthful reporting, fair process, resources and repair; suffering doesn't confer legitimacy automatically. 邦/国 name-taboo explanation is important but practices vary; Mawangdui copies also show historical layers, not unaltered autograph. 正言若反 not inverse truth test or proof all water/leadership outcomes certain.

79.coverage: 7 sections: settled dispute with cold relation; 和怨余怨; adopted右介 vs received左契 and system-vs-blame incident/early questions; 德司介/无德司彻 with mediation burden and cultivation; 天道无亲; practices;78/73/77/27/80 links.
79.corrections: ‘必有余怨’ emphasizes limits of settlement; don't declare every conflict permanently unhealable or justice useless. ‘必有余怨’ is4characters, not3. Right/left contract readings and介/契 relations have serious basis; author's崇尚调停 philosophical reading not a proven dictionary restoration. Remove erroneous 右丞相李斯 evidence (official title doesn't proveverbfavor). 彻 can relate fields AND levy/tax tradition; 公刘彻田为粮 doesn't exclude tax sense here. 无德=not-yet-trained is constructive application not obligatory literal meaning; agricultural work not morally lower or needsnoethicaljudgment. No mandatory career hierarchy/no person assigned labor by moralworth. Systems review coexists with proportionate accountability, justice and safety; no perfect process that never fails. Mediators consent/competence/limits, not swallowing all abuse or forcing victim reunion. Prevention doesn't justify prying/control. 天道 moral/philosophical hope not empirical guarantee or universal reward; worth not contingent on contribution.

80.coverage: 8 sections: challenging familiar backward-utopia reading; 小邦 and 什佰 military alternative/boatsarms; 重死/远徙; knot records; foodclothescustomhome and socialcomparison; neighbors/consent; practices;31/69/57/65/final81 links.
80.corrections: No 'misread for2000yrs' or all dictionary controversy solved. 什佰 military grouping plausible interpretive route, not sole sense; boats/carts civilian too. Smallness doesn't protect from conquest. 重身=pregnant doesn't establish重死=natural reproduction/death; explicitly remove unsupported lexical derivation, common重死=take death seriously.
